sources.note: The catalog entry: a generic strip (own work, no brand) with FOUR outputs out-1 to out-4, each an IEC C13 (mains-power, isMainsSource). Following its connector ids: C13 outlets, not Schuko. The catalog note says no switch, fuse or cord is modelled for the simulation: the rocker and the cord stub of the model are looks only (no control, no port, nothing to patch).

IEC 60320 C13 outlet, the same outline and slots as the iec-c14 / iec-c13 specs: 25.4 x 17.4 mm opening with the two lower corners cut, line and neutral slots 14 mm apart at y -2, earth at y +2 (the standard sheets were not available: sizes are the repo's iec-c13 / iec-c14 estimates).

ESTIMATE of the strip's size from real horizontal C13 distribution bars (web search 2026-11-10; the 4-outlet datasheet itself was not found): a 12-outlet 1U Assmann bar is 45 mm high and 45 mm deep, Connectorco's 6-way horizontal PDU range is 60 x 45 mm in section. The model uses 52 mm high (a little taller than the 45 mm bars so that the 37.5 mm marker ring of a C13 lies on the flat front) x 50 mm deep. The outlet pitch of 40 mm, the 9 mm outlet depth, the 236 mm length (206 mm bar plus a 30 mm cord stub with its boot), the 5 mm rounded edges, the 2 mm feet and the 24 x 14 mm rocker window are ESTIMATES by us (a generic strip has no single product to measure). Every port position is a guess for that reason.
